title: Mad Science (v2 On-Beat Boom-Bap)
style: Underground boom-bap hip-hop, 88 BPM, heavy head-nod drums, steady crisp snare on beats 2 and 4, warm dusty jazz piano loop, deep sub bass, raspy masked male emcee, calm conversational flow, rhyming locked tightly on the beat, MF DOOM style.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Hunched in the cellar like a dungeon lurker
Cooking secret venom on a Bunsen burner
Dusty iron mask and a steady grin
Pouring liquid zinc from the bottle in
Drop toxic liquid in, turn the cold dial
Pop lock-pick, wicked grin, burn the old file
Cold smile, no denial, make the villain choke
Vanished in a puffy cloud of steam and smoke
